data.title: The blue gate

memoryNodes.cue: The path is a way into the courtyard.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 小路是进入院子的通道。

memoryNodes.cue: A ticket allows entry to one workshop.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 一张票允许进入一场工作坊。

memoryNodes.cue: The visitor can find the cafe on the map.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 访客可以在地图上找到咖啡馆。

data.situation:
By ten on Saturday, the blue gate was open. The only access to the courtyard was a narrow path from River Street, away from the damaged floor. Lin hung her coat behind the entrance desk. A coach stopped near the bakery, and its courier walked the group down the path. He had arranged their visit and stayed to help anyone who needed directions. River Street Market
Free entry to the courtyard market.
Card-making workshop: a nominal fee of £2 covers the materials.
Workshop tickets give access to the small room at eleven.
Please select a session before paying. The bread-making session and the card-making session run at the same time. Visitor: Do I have to pay just to look at the stalls?
Lin: No, there is free entry to the market. The card workshop costs two pounds.
Visitor: What is my other option?
Lin: You can walk around the stalls without joining a workshop. This little map is handy if you want to find the cafe.
Visitor: Thank you. I'll select a workshop after I've had a look.

readingBlocks.en: By ten on Saturday, the blue gate was open. The only access to the courtyard was a narrow path from River Street, away from the damaged floor. Lin hung her coat behind the entrance desk. A coach stopped near the bakery, and its courier walked the group down the path. He had arranged their visit and stayed to help anyone who needed directions.
readingBlocks.zh: 周六十点，蓝色院门已经打开。进入院子的唯一通道，是从河街来的一条小路，避开了损坏的地板。林把外套挂在入口桌后。一辆大巴停在面包店附近，随团导游带着一行人沿小路走来。他安排了这次参观，并留下来帮助需要指路的人。

readingBlocks.en:
River Street Market
Free entry to the courtyard market.
Card-making workshop: a nominal fee of £2 covers the materials.
Workshop tickets give access to the small room at eleven.
Please select a session before paying. The bread-making session and the card-making session run at the same time.
readingBlocks.zh:
河街集市
院子里的集市免费入场。
卡片制作工作坊：收取少量费用两英镑，用于材料。
工作坊门票允许持票者十一点进入小房间。
付款前请选定场次。面包制作与卡片制作同时进行。
readingBlocks.title: At the entrance desk

readingBlocks.en:
Visitor: Do I have to pay just to look at the stalls?
Lin: No, there is free entry to the market. The card workshop costs two pounds.
Visitor: What is my other option?
Lin: You can walk around the stalls without joining a workshop. This little map is handy if you want to find the cafe.
Visitor: Thank you. I'll select a workshop after I've had a look.
readingBlocks.zh:
访客：只是看看摊位也得付钱吗？
林：不用，集市免费入场。卡片工作坊是两英镑。
访客：我还有什么选择？
林：你可以不参加工作坊，只逛摊位。要找咖啡馆的话，这张小地图很有用。
访客：谢谢。我先看看，再选工作坊。

glossary.note: 本句指进入地点的通道；与允许进入的权利不同。
glossary.example: The only access to the courtyard is the path beside the bakery.
glossary.exampleZh: 进入院子的唯一通道，是面包店旁的小路。

externalEvidence.definition: a way of entering or leaving

glossary.zh: 进入或使用的权利、机会
glossary.note: 本句指凭票获得进入的权利或机会；与实体通道不同。
glossary.example: Workshop tickets give access to the small room.
glossary.exampleZh: 工作坊门票允许持票者进入小房间。

glossary.note: entry to + 场所；只保证市场入场免费，工作坊可单独收费。
glossary.example: There is free entry to the courtyard market.
glossary.exampleZh: 院子里的集市免费入场。

glossary.note: 只教费用很小的用法；原名义上的另义不并入此入口。
glossary.example: The card workshop charges a nominal fee of two pounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 卡片工作坊收取少量费用两英镑。

externalEvidence.definition: insignificantly small; a matter of form only (`tokenish' is informal)

glossary.zh: 可供选择的办法或选项
glossary.note: 可数名词；不是金融期权；两条相同源义共用。
glossary.example: Walking around without joining a workshop is another option.
glossary.exampleZh: 不参加工作坊而逛摊位，是另一个选择。

externalEvidence.definition: one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen

glossary.note: 动词select + 选项，正式程度略高于choose，此处为售票说明。
glossary.example: Please select a session before paying.

externalEvidence.definition: pick out, select, or choose from a number of alternatives

glossary.note: 形容地图方便有用，不指做手工熟练，也不等于所有handy都在手边。
glossary.example: This map is handy if you want to find the cafe.
glossary.exampleZh: 如果你想找咖啡馆，这张地图很有用。

externalEvidence.findingZh: easy to use / useful义适合这张地图。

glossary.zh: 随团导游；照料旅行团的工作人员
glossary.note: 这里指安排、陪同并照料旅行团的工作人员；不是配送包裹的信使。
glossary.example: The coach courier guides the visitors down the path.
glossary.exampleZh: 大巴的随团导游带访客沿小路走去。

externalEvidence.findingZh: 词条含照料旅行团、安排及陪同旅行的工作人员，不套入信使义。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor asks whether browsing the stalls costs anything. Explain the market and workshop charges.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 访客问逛摊位是否收费。说明集市和工作坊的费用。
acceptableAnswers: There is free entry to the market. The card workshop has a nominal fee of two pounds.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain what a ticket allows the visitor to do and what they should choose before paying.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明一张票允许访客做什么，以及付款前应该选什么。
acceptableAnswers: The ticket gives access to the small room. Please select a session before paying.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: A visitor does not want a workshop. Offer another way to spend the morning and something to help them find places.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 访客不想参加工作坊。提供另一种度过上午的办法，以及方便找地点的东西。
acceptableAnswers: Another option is to walk around the stalls. This map is handy for finding the cafe.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
